name: National Air and Space Museum
description: The Smithsonian's national museum of flight and spaceflight, on the National Mall.

items.apollo-csm-block-ii: Command module Columbia, flown on Apollo 11 (1969)
items.apollo-lm: Lunar module LM-2, built for flight and never flown
items.gemini: Gemini IV capsule, flown on the first American spacewalk mission (1965)
items.mercury-capsule: Friendship 7, flown by John Glenn on the first American orbital flight (1962)
items./science/history/apollo-11-1969: Command module Columbia, flown on Apollo 11
items.merlin-1d: A flown Merlin 1D engine, donated by SpaceX in 2022
items.sojourner: Marie Curie, the flight spare of the Sojourner rover
items.tundra-sirius: Sirius FM-4, a flight-ready satellite that was never launched
items.planet-labs: An early Dove satellite, a flight unit donated by Planet Labs
items.skylab: The backup Skylab orbital workshop, which you can walk through
items.lrv-apollo: The Lunar Roving Vehicle qualification test unit
